newsitem.title: USA: Innerdyne hopeful for late 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: Innerdyne hopeful for late 1997 profit.

text.p: InnerDyne Inc expects by late 1997 to begin reporting profits from its minimally invasive surgical (MIS) products, President and Chief Executive Officer William Mavity said.
"We are strongly focused on a bottom line profit and hope to deliver on that goal in late 1997," Mavity told the Cruttenden Roth Growth Stock Conference here.
He said the company has been growing revenues at a compounded quarterly rate of 20 percent since the third quarter of 1995, while growing operating expenses at a slower 8.4 percent rate.

The company estimates the size of the worldwide market for its MIS devices at $300 million. It is also developing other technologies, such as a bio-compatible coating for the stents used in heart patients.
